source.n8n_access: read-only GET /executions only; no live transport failure has been observed. Input is the error item media-extract-http emits under onError=continueRegularOutput.
source.rationale: media-extract-http has a 40 s timeout and runs with onError=continueRegularOutput, so a CRM timeout/5xx hands media-route an item with no `decision` at all. The turn must NOT dead-end silently: the first guard in the file catches the missing decision and replies with the CRM-owned fallback copy for this modality, copied byte-exact from wording.py. Note reply_text here is the bare fallback and does NOT go through appendNotices - there are no notices to append when the request never landed. The error string is preserved in _media_trace.transport_error (and only there: crm_error stays null because that slot means 'the CRM answered and reported an error', which is a different incident to debug).
